title: Earth Ring
description: To give Earth a planetary ring
body:
## Description
### This project was completed between February and March 2025.

This resource pack adds a planetary ring to Earth for use with [Cosmic Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/cosmic-horizons-cosmos).

The ring is visible from space or other planets, and is also directly visible from the overworld.

## Installation
## Data Pack

1. Place the downloaded folder into your world's folder.datapacks.

2. Alternatively: You can place the entire downloaded  file directly into the folder without extracting it**.zip****.datapacks**.

## Resource Pack

1. Place the downloaded folder into your Minecraft  folder**.resourcepacks**.

2. Alternatively: You can place the entire downloaded  file directly into the  folder without extracting it**.zip****.resourcepacks**.
